label: GO step, confidently choosing a2 after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Reset-gate unit that fires almost only at GO when the agent is about to choose a2 (strong a2 policy logit, choice < -4.4 on every active step) and the previous trial was unrewarded (in_rew 0 at D1). 92% of activation mass is at GO; never fires at D1, never when choosing a1, and hardly ever after a rewarded trial. A weak low-magnitude tail at D2 when S2 is reached after a2 (8% of mass) is not covered. Precision is limited: many GO a2-after-no-reward steps stay silent; firing also depends strongly on episode time (peaks at trials 30-50, silent after trial 80, absent early), which I could not tie to an observable task variable, so it probably reflects slow hidden-state drift. Restricting to trials 15-75 raises dev F1 only to 0.57. Recorded predicate uses only observed history and the models own policy logit (no future variables); action==2 instead of choice<-6 gives similar recall with lower precision (dev F1 0.48).
